body:
Source: GitHub issue #594 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 7f45efd5: `packages/coldstart/lib/gate.mjs:33` (buildCheckTicket) and `:62` (the ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE test seam in checkTicket) coerce anything that is not literally an array at `parsed.gaps` into `[]`. `extractJson` only throws on unparseable text, so a well-formed JSON response of the wrong shape parses fine and collapses to "no gaps": `[{"what":"UserSchema","why_blocking":"missing"}]` (the model DID find a blocker, returned as a bare array) → PASS exit 0; `{"blockers":[…]}`, `{"gaps":null}`, `{"gaps":"two gaps found"}`, `{"result":"ok"}` → PASS exit 0. The zero-gap verdict is then written to the gate-manifest as clean P0/P2 evidence and cached for --max-age days. The lenient behaviour is pinned by `test/coldstart.test.mjs` ('checkTicket treats missing/invalid gaps field as empty array') and the mock-seam test ('handles invalid JSON in ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE gracefully').

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/coldstart`: bin/coldstart.mjs (calls checkAll / checkTicket; LLM/parse errors reach `opError('LLM call failed: …')` → exit 1; gaps → exit 2; none → `[PASS]` exit 0; records to the gate-manifest unless mocked), lib/gate.mjs (buildCheckTicket, checkTicket with the NODE_ENV=test + ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE seam, checkAll with content-addressed cache), lib/cache.mjs (`findCachedVerdict(entries, {ticketHash, model, maxAgeMs, now})` returns `{gaps}` from a prior manifest entry), lib/verdict.mjs, lib/report.mjs, lib/prompt.mjs. Tests in test/*.test.mjs (`npm test -w packages/coldstart`); test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs and test/checkall-cache.test.mjs show how to build a temp ticket store + ADLC_DIR fixture and drive the CLI with the mock seam.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add ONE exported pure function `normalizeGaps(parsed)` (suggested home: lib/verdict.mjs) that returns the gaps array when `parsed` is `{ gaps: Array }` OR a bare top-level Array (the most common model deviation, recovered). Each entry must be an object (keep as-is; `what` should be a string) or a string (wrap as `{ what: <string>, why_blocking: 'unspecified' }`). ANY other input throws an Error whose message starts with `coldstart: unreadable executability verdict —` and describes the received shape briefly (type / top-level keys; never more than ~200 characters of raw text). Throwing cases include at least: `null`, `undefined`, numbers, strings, `{}`, `{result:'ok'}`, `{blockers:[…]}`, `{gaps:null}`, `{gaps:'text'}`, `{gaps:{}}`, `{gaps:[42]}`, `{gaps:[null]}`.
2. buildCheckTicket uses normalizeGaps on the extracted JSON. The throw propagates to the bin's existing operational-error path (exit 1). Make sure the operator sees the real cause: the bin's message must include the normalizeGaps message (adjust the `LLM call failed:` wrapper text if needed so it reads as "could not read the verdict", not as a network failure).
3. The ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE seam in checkTicket uses the SAME normalizeGaps: an unparseable or shape-deviant mock now throws (fail closed, matching the real path) instead of silently becoming `{}` → `[]`. Update the two pinning tests in test/coldstart.test.mjs to assert the new contract, and adjust any other test that sets an off-shape mock.
4. Cache read path: in lib/cache.mjs `findCachedVerdict`, run the candidate entry's stored `gaps` through normalizeGaps; an entry whose gaps do not normalize is NOT a hit (skip it and keep looking / fall through to a fresh audit). A cached verdict must never green the gate on an unreadable shape.
5. Documentation: in `packages/coldstart/README.md` document the accepted verdict shapes (`{"gaps":[…]}` or a bare array) and that anything else is exit 1 "could not read the verdict" (not a pass); make the SAME edit by hand in the mirrors `docs/tools/coldstart.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/coldstart.mdx` (hand-maintained — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 normalizeGaps table: `{gaps:[]}`→`[]`; `{gaps:[{what:'a'}]}`→same; `[{what:'a'}]`→`[{what:'a'}]`; `{gaps:['x']}`→`[{what:'x',why_blocking:'unspecified'}]`; throws (message /unreadable executability verdict/) for every case listed in item 1. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/verdict-shape.test.mjs`
- AC2 `buildCheckTicket(stub returning '[{"what":"UserSchema","why_blocking":"missing"}]', extractJson)` resolves with gaps of length 1; a stub returning `{"result":"ok"}` rejects with /unreadable executability verdict/. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/verdict-shape.test.mjs`
- AC3 CLI, via the mock seam against a temp store: `ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE='{"result":"ok"}'` → exit 1, stderr contains `unreadable executability verdict`, stdout has no `[PASS]`; `'{"gaps":[]}'` → exit 0 (regression); `'[{"what":"x","why_blocking":"y"}]'` → exit 2 listing the gap; `'not json'` → exit 1. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/verdict-shape.test.mjs`
- AC4 A manifest entry whose `data.cache.gaps` (or wherever the cache stores it — read cache.mjs) is the string `"clean"` is not a cache hit; an entry with `gaps: []` still is. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/verdict-shape.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green with the two pinning tests rewritten (say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/coldstart`
- AC6 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "bare array" packages/coldstart/README.md docs/tools/coldstart.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/coldstart.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: #595 (cache trusting unsigned manifest entries) — do not add signature verification here; item 4 is shape validation only.

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/verdict-shape.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: `npm test -w packages/coldstart`, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then `npx adversarial-review --base origin/main --provider codex --timeout 600` and loop review→fix→re-review until exit 0 with ZERO findings and no warning lines (read findings[] every round; exit 0 alone is not the signal). Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/coldstart/**, the three docs files, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(coldstart): ...`, body must contain `Closes #594`.
title: coldstart: a shape-deviant LLM verdict is an operational error (exit 1), never zero gaps; accept a bare top-level gaps array
